senses.gloss:
ज्यका f. (-का) The chord of an are.
 E. ज्या the same, कन् added.
ज्या r. 9th cl. (जिनाति) To decay, to be or become old. क्य्रा० प्वा० पर० अक० अनिट् ।

ज्या f. (ज्या)
 1. A mother.
 2. The earth, 3. A bowstring.
 4. The chord
of an are.
 E. ज्या to become old, to decay, affixes अघ्न्या० यक् ।

ज्याघोष m. (-षः) Twang of a bow.
 E. ज्या, and घोष sound.

ज्यानि f. (-निः)
 1. Old age, decay, infirmity.
 2. Abandoning, quitting,
leaving.
 3. A river, a stream.
 E. ज्या to decay, &c. Uṇādi aff. नि.

ज्यायस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
 1. Very old.
 2. Very excellent, best.
 3. Su-
perior, Elder, elder born.
 4. In law, one independent (come of age)
and answerable for his own conduct.
 E. ज्या to be old, ईयसुन् affix.
अतिशयेन प्रशस्यः वृद्धः वा ।

ज्यष्ठाश्रम m. (-मः)
 1. The order of the householder.
 2. A householder.
E. ज्येष्ठ, and आश्रम order.
